implemented: No-identity calls rejected at registry dispatch, shared desktop side-effect guard, local file entry/executor, desktop resolve/activate/action, browser session acquisition, and model chat/stream entry.
Registry handler accessors route through the same checked execution entry rather than exposing registered handlers.
Authorization grants for registry/model/browser dispatch bind exact goal, graph, node, operation, attempt, tool and argument hash.
Grant checks include expiry, revocation, finite use count, per-goal/tool rate limit, and transactionally consumed dispatch receipt.
Browser facade checks execution identity, session validity, method arguments and handle lineage; raw objects are not exposed through prototypes/descriptors.
Conflicting model provenance is rejected; escaped async work from closed node scopes is rejected.

tests.browserTests: Facade enforcement tested with synthetic handles; no live browser acceptance claim.

evidenceStates.allowedFixture: Synthetic handler returned expected text: SUCCEEDED; not independent real-world verification

inventory.coverage: Static pattern candidates, not an exhaustive call-graph proof. Per-entry review incomplete.

remainingCriticalGaps: Legacy callers at guarded entry points are blocked, not all rebound to executable canonical nodes.
Other process/network/filesystem entry points need review and enforcement; global absence of bypasses is NOT established.
No human approval UI or trusted issuance bridge issues these new grants. Test grants exist only in the isolated test database.
Approval references in grants are not yet independently resolved against the existing approval service. Revocation tested here is grant revocation.
Argument hashes are exact invocation scopes, not semantic path confinement, symlink protection or OS filesystem isolation.
Browser facade is a restrictive intermediate boundary; all typed browser operations and multi-user authenticated-session confinement remain unaccepted.
Hostname-derived vault fallback and outbound network confinement remain unchanged and incomplete.
Uniform independent postcondition verification remains incomplete.
Isolated-worker, installed-runtime, Unicode and physical acceptance have not run for this build.
ownership: Existing GoalLifecycle and TaskGraphExecutor retained. Authorization tables contain permissions and dispatch receipts, not task lifecycle. Journal remains evidence projection.
